blocks.text: Several international frameworks guide responsible AI use. The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) from the European Union enforces strict rules on data privacy and user rights. AI Ethics Guidelines developed by organizations worldwide emphasize accountability, fairness, and respect for human dignity. These frameworks encourage nations and companies to adopt responsible AI practices.

For Pakistan, creating national AI policies is crucial to promote innovation while ensuring ethical compliance. Such policies can regulate data protection, encourage research, and support the development of AI solutions that align with local values and needs. Implementing ethical standards helps build public trust, attract global partnerships, and ensure that AI contributes positively to national growth.
